sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression quantified by flow cytometry / FACS anti-myc immunostaining in non-permeabilized HEK293 cells; channel folding, trafficking, and function explicitly reported as unaffected (PMC7988323, DOI:10.1101/2020.07.29.227231). GOF variants carrying this tag were used in functional studies without caveat.
sites.rationale: All ledger lines converge on a single junction: insert_after_residue=146 (E) / residue_after=147 (Q). Computed from the canonical sequence: seq[145]='E', seq[146]='Q', confirming the paper's Glu146/Gln147 naming exactly matches the canonical isoform without any offset correction. Topology landmarks place position 146 inside the EXTRACELLULAR span 144–154 (S1–S2 loop), 3 aa from the S1 TM end (143) and 9 aa from the S2 TM start (155); both distances satisfy the ≥3 aa rule. The loop is 11 residues long; the published myc tag (10 aa) was tolerated, making a 15–23 aa ALFA+GS insert sterically plausible by the same precedent. The BBS-tagged construct in PMC12218124 was not assigned to a specific residue in the ledger and therefore cannot be reported as a separate site. Primary supporting source is PMC7988323 (and its preprint DOI:10.1101/2020.07.29.227231); corroborated by PMC5842040, PMC13041670, PMC12724399, DOI:10.64898/2025.12.15.25341924, and DOI:10.1101/2025.10.13.682066. [validation: surface_and_function; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The c-myc tag (EQKLISEEDL) was inserted into the extracellular S1–S2 linker between residues Glu146 and Gln147.
